title: Caltech Researchers Claim Radical Compression of High-Fidelity AI Models
raw_excerpt: PrismML has developed an extreme form of compression that allows AI to run locally on edge devices. Its 1-bit technology model has a radically compressed size without compromised performance. The same efficiency gains that enable local deployment will also allow data centers to operate more efficiently. The mathematics for the process are proprietary, with Caltech owning the intellectual property and PrismML being the sole exclusive licensee.
summary: Caltech 衍生公司 PrismML 推出 1-Bit Bonsai 模型，号称首个商业可行的 1 比特 LLM。该技术通过极端压缩使 AI 能在边缘设备本地运行，同时保持高性能，并提升数据中心效率。数学方法为专有，Caltech 拥有知识产权。

title: OpenAI raised $122B to expand AI infrastructure
raw_excerpt: OpenAI announced $122 billion in new funding at an $852 billion valuation, highlighting rapid revenue growth, large-scale adoption, and a strategy centered on compute, APIs, and enterprise AI systems.
summary: OpenAI 宣布完成 1220 亿美元新一轮融资，估值达 8520 亿美元。资金将用于扩展 AI 基础设施，凸显其营收高速增长和大规模采用，战略聚焦于算力、API 和企业 AI 系统。

title: Qwen3.5-Omni: Scaling Up, Toward Native Omni-Modal AGI
raw_excerpt: Qwen3.5-Omni is a full omnimodal large language model that understands text, images, audio, and audio-visual content. It can process more than 10 hours of audio input and over 400 seconds of 720P audio-visual input at 1 FPS. The model is trained on a massive amount of text and visual data, and more than 100 million hours of audio-visual data. It supports speech recognition in 113 languages and dialects and speech generation in 36 languages and dialects.
summary: 阿里通义千问发布 Qwen3.5-Omni，一个全模态大模型，支持文本、图像、音频和音视频理解。可处理超 10 小时音频输入和 400 秒 720P 音视频输入，支持 113 种语言语音识别和 36 种语言语音生成。

title: Granite 4.0 3B Vision: Compact Multimodal Intelligence for Enterprise Documents
summary: IBM 发布 Granite 4.0 3B Vision，一个紧凑的多模态模型，专为企业文档处理设计。该模型在保持小参数量的同时，具备强大的文档理解能力，适合企业级部署。

title: Claude Code's source code appears to have leaked: here's what we know
raw_excerpt: Anthropic has accidentally leaked the inner workings of Claude Code to the public. The codebase has now been mirrored and analyzed by thousands of developers. The most significant discovery seems to be how Anthropic solved context entropy by using a three-layer memory architecture. This post looks at other interesting parts of the code and the implications of the leak.
summary: Anthropic 的 Claude Code 源代码意外泄露，被数千开发者镜像分析。最大发现是其三层记忆架构如何解决上下文熵问题。泄露揭示了 Anthropic 在代码助手工程上的独特设计。

title: Training mRNA Language Models Across 25 Species for $165
summary: 研究团队以仅 165 美元的成本训练了跨 25 个物种的 mRNA 语言模型。该工作展示了在有限预算下进行生物序列建模的可行性，对药物发现和合成生物学有重要意义。

title: Improve coding agents' performance with Gemini API Docs MCP and Agent Skills
raw_excerpt: Agents can generate outdated Gemini API code due to outdated training data. Google has introduced the Gemini API Docs MCP and the Gemini API Developer Skills to fix this. The tools are designed to ensure coding agents have access to the most up-to-date APIs and code using best practices. Combined, they lead to a 96.3% pass rate on Google's eval set.
summary: Google 推出 Gemini API Docs MCP 和 Agent Skills，确保编码代理使用最新 API 和最佳实践。结合使用后，在 Google 评估集上达到 96.3% 的通过率，显著提升代码生成质量。

title: Microsoft 365 Copilot gets Critique and Council modes
raw_excerpt: Microsoft 365 Copilot has introduced Critique and Council modes to enhance research capabilities. Critique uses a dual-model system to generate and refine research drafts, outperforming single-model solutions by 13.88% on the DRACO benchmark. Council allows parallel report generation using Anthropic and OpenAI models for impactful comparison and insight aggregation.
summary: Microsoft 365 Copilot 新增 Critique 和 Council 模式。Critique 使用双模型系统生成和完善研究草稿，在 DRACO 基准上性能提升 13.88%；Council 允许并行使用 Anthropic 和 OpenAI 模型生成报告，便于对比和聚合洞察。

title: Mercor says it was hit by cyberattack tied to compromise of open-source LiteLLM project
raw_excerpt: Mercor, an AI recruiting startup, has confirmed a security incident linked to a supply chain attack involving LiteLLM. A recent compromise of LiteLLM's project, linked to a hacking group called TeamPCP, has affected thousands of companies. Lapsus$, an extortion hacking group, claims it has access to the stolen data, though it is unclear how it was obtained. The incident has prompted LiteLLM to shift from Delve to Vanta for compliance certifications.
summary: AI 招聘初创公司 Mercor 确认遭遇网络安全事件，与开源项目 LiteLLM 的供应链攻击有关。黑客组织 Lapsus$ 声称已获取被盗数据。事件促使 LiteLLM 更换合规认证供应商。

title: Ollama is now powered by MLX on Apple Silicon in preview
summary: Ollama 宣布在 Apple Silicon 上预览版使用 MLX 作为后端。这将显著提升 Mac 上本地运行大模型的性能和效率，为 Apple 生态的 AI 开发提供更强大的支持。
